Mina (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — leadership asked for a concise public timeline for Console batching controls, API tiers, and Optimize suggestions. can we lock something today?

Oliver (Eng): short commit: Console batching internal canary 2024-06-26, partner beta 2024-07-10, GA 2024-07-24 (pending certify). API tiers beta 2024-07-29, GA target 2024-08-15. Optimize (read-only hints) 2024-06-30; write-mode TBD early Sept.

Tasha (DevEx): will draft migration checklist + AE script. can we standardize the opt-out example? we should publish the endpoint and the sample payload.

Oliver (Eng): opt-out sample: PUT /v1/tenant/features {"smart_batching": false} (admin only). will add per-route override as well.

Ben (Sales): sales request: partner beta needs a clear rollback path and a one-page FAQ AEs can use. also want a sample customer message for enterprise accounts.

Rui (Legal): legal: send proposed tier terms by July 1 and we'll return redline by July 10. also need data use wording for Optimize suggestions.

sre-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime v1.9.3 -> us-west on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z (4 nodes).

Mina (Product): product actions: (1) publish single-page timeline with footnotes (owner: Mina) by EOD, (2) migration checklist + AE script (owner: Tasha) by July 3, (3) partner FAQ (owner: Ben) by July 5, (4) legal terms sent to Rui by July 1.

Oliver (Eng): engineering will open canary PRs by 2024-06-21. telemetry items: batching ratio, p50/p95 token latency, and per-tenant opt-out logs.

Mina (Product): thanks all — i'll post the timeline in #all-hands and #customer-comm and pin it. please tag me on any blockers. :spiral_calendar_pad:
